fichas.title: Small Sewage Treatment Plants
fichas.summary: Small sewage treatment plants treat wastewater where connection to municipal treatment works is unavailable or impractical. The process combines mechanical settling in a multi-chamber sedimentation tank with biological treatment in a filter trench, trickle filter, or underground filtration system. The page describes treatment layouts, wastewater production assumptions, and tank sizing under DIN 4261-1.
